_comment: Blotato MCP for the POSTING step only. Get the exact hosted URL from help.blotato.com/api/mcp - do not guess it. Comment-READING is NOT here; that's the Graph API (see scripts/prove_graph_comments.py).
_fallback: If MCP auth is fiddly in CI, skip this file and have the cycle prompt curl the REST API at https://backend.blotato.com/v2 with header blotato-api-key directly (same surface, fewer moving parts). prove_blotato_post.py already uses the REST path so you'll have confirmed it works.
